about: Every game system the mashup touches. One row = one Java class (its javaClass). Minecraft is the host and the player; Paint the Town Red supplies the level, the people in it and their brawl rules.

columns.side: common (pure Java, no Minecraft), server, or client
columns.javaClass: The class this row generates/implements, relative to mod/src/<set>/java
columns.reads: ptr_sources ids it reads (comma separated, '-' for none)
columns.rules: brawl_rules ids it implements (comma separated, '-' for none)
columns.verifiedBy: The oracle that proves it (bench or in-game check)

rows.summary: Find PTR's install folder from Steam's library folders
Read UnityFS bundles (LZ4 blocks on demand), serialized files and type trees
Decode the Addressables catalog to find assets by path or GUID
Decode Texture2D (DXT1, DXT5, RGBA32, RGB24, ARGB32, Alpha8) to RGBA
rows.verifiedBy: bench textures (compare with UnityPy PNG export)

rows.summary: Decode Mesh vertex streams and index buffers
rows.verifiedBy: bench extract (triangle and vertex counts vs UnityPy)

rows.summary: Turn the Biker Bar scene into draw batches, collision, the spawn point and the people, in Minecraft coordinates, cached per PTR build
Read each person's settings, appearance, pose and the Blockman rig
Write and read the extracted level (binary + PNGs) under <instance>/ptrcraft/cache/<buildid>
rows.verifiedBy: bench extract then reload (round trip, equal counts)

rows.summary: An invisible, unbreakable block whose shape per position is PTR's collision voxelized at 1/8 block, so Steve walks, jumps and builds on the real bar
rows.verifiedBy: in-game: walk the bar, stand on the counter, place a block on a table

rows.summary: Create the 'Paint the Town Red - Biker Bar' world (void, survival, cheats on), place the collision blocks and spawn the people once
rows.verifiedBy: in-game: new world shows the bar around the player

rows.summary: Put the Minecraft player where PTR's player starts, facing the same way, with a starter hotbar
rows.verifiedBy: in-game: first join lands at PTR's start

rows.summary: The Brawler entity: one per PTR person, with PTR's per-type numbers
rows.verifiedBy: in-game: 81 brawlers present after world creation

rows.summary: PTR's bar brawl: calm until a fight starts, then everyone fights the player and each other
rows.verifiedBy: in-game: punch one biker, the bar erupts; bikers hit each other

rows.summary: Draw the bar's real meshes with their PTR textures inside Minecraft's world pass
Draw each brawler as PTR's Blockman with its PTR outfit and face, posed and animated (walk, punch, knocked down)
Register the cached PTR textures as Minecraft textures
Read PTR in the background at start, then open the Biker Bar world straight from the title screen (button to re-enter, notice when PTR is missing)
rows.verifiedBy: in-game: launch -> lands in the bar without clicks
